text:
maria.releases: Quick heads-up — aiming to merge release/v0.22.0-rc1 -> staging in ~2h (cutoff 12:00 UTC). Need: version bump, changelog entry, security signoff, QA smoke + canary. PRs to watch: #4123 (runtime perf), #4130 (docs/changelog), #4135 (infra). Please drop short ack and any blockers.

jake.runtime: I have the version bump ready in #4140 — includes `setup.py` and `version.txt` edits. Patch shows `v0.22.0-rc1`. Can someone with merge rights pull that if CI is green?

priya.qa: I'm on smoke now. Running the quick harness (`./tools/smoke.sh staging --concurrency 5`). ETA ~20m. Please avoid any more feature merges until we finish smoke.

oliver.security: I'll run the quick security checklist and SAST scan. Noted that Snyk flagged a transient dev-dep in #4123 earlier; can we confirm it's dev-only?

tessa.docs: I updated the changelog in #4130 — added the runtime perf improvements and the batching tweak. Left a TODO for a tiny wording tweak under "Regression Risk" — would love a quick read.

qa-bot: smoke: in_progress (started by priya.qa). e2e: queued.

jake.runtime: thanks @priya.qa — re: #4123 the flagged package is only in the dev Dockerfile for local profiling. I'll add a comment in the PR and pin the dev-only version to silence Snyk.

oliver.security: ok ping me once that's in — I won't be able to sign off until Snyk goes green or we document the risk.

priya.qa: smoke passed on core flows (auth, generation, kv-cache). failures: one flaky embedding test — investigating. Attaching short log:
```
ASSERTION FAILED: similarity_index > 0.8
context: embeddings/indexer_test.py:42
```
Will rerun after Jake's merge freeze.

jake.runtime: pushed a tiny change to #4141 to pin the dev dep and a follow-up to fix the embedding test seed (should be deterministic now).

deploy-bot: canary job scheduled for 12:30 UTC on staging (image: redwood/inference:v0.22.0-rc1).

maria.releases: Great — can @oliver.security and @priya.qa give final +1s by 11:50 UTC? If both thumbs up, I'll merge release PRs and tag. Also reminder: update /docs/release-notes with the short bullet list (Tessa has the changelog PR).

oliver.security: +1 conditional on #4141 pin applied and Snyk passing. I'll re-run SAST after that.

priya.qa: +1 for smoke and basic e2e. I'll keep an eye on the embedding flake but won't block RC for that if it's only one non-blocking test.

tessa.docs: I'll sync the changelog into release-notes after merge and add the "known issues" line about the embedding flake.

jake.runtime: all done — #4141 merged, CI green.

qa-bot: smoke: passed. e2e: started (approx 15m).

oliver.security: Snyk clean now, SAST queued — should finish in ~5m.

maria.releases: Perfect. Merging in 30m unless any late objections. Tag command I'll run: `git tag -a v0.22.0-rc1 -m "rc1" && git push origin v0.22.0-rc1`. After tag, I'll kick the canary. :rocket:

jake.runtime: thanks all. If any rollback needed, we have the previous stable tag v0.21.3.

deploy-bot: canary started at 12:30 UTC (tracking: #canary-1798004567).

maria.releases: Merged and tagged. Canary running. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. I'll post the rollout notes once canary hits 100% on staging. :tada:
